label: Early-sequence bigram detector: steps 1-2 where the current token is one of c/v/i/2/d/q/3 and the previous token is one of 2/3/c/l/h/x/d/1
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at t=1 (71% of mass) and t=2 (29%); never at t=0, t>=3 (3 stray hits), the delimiter or the copy phase. Within those steps it acts like an additive lookup on the current input (strongest c, v, i, then 2, d, q, 3; weaker l, o, x; almost never 0 or h) and the previous input (strongest 2, 3, c, then l, h, x, d, 1). Top activations are 3-2-c / 3-2-v at t=2 and c-2-c / c-2-v, so the first token also contributes at t=2. It is stronger at t=1 than t=2 and on first occurrences of the token. The conjunction gets dev F1 0.71 / mass recall 0.87. It misses weaker activations from pairs outside the token sets, and it over-fires at t=2 when the first token is unfavourable. Requiring prev2_tok to be favourable as well raises precision to 0.91 but lowers recall.
